content.text: Replace this text and the input_json data with actual validated evidence for this question batch.

questions.name: C08
questions.instructions: How actionable is the purchase call-to-action within the available posting context? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No purchase action in inspected video/post metadata.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Clear intent but unclear purchase path.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Specific action linked to visible shopping flow.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Timely clear purchase instruction with consistent accessible purchase path.
